symptom: DesignProperties: ('Hoover': ON, 'Shadow': 'Tiny') warned MDL-WIDGET11/12 and exec wrote both into the page.
cause: Both rules were warnings on the theory that a newer theme may add keys the snapshot lacks — but the registry is read from the project's own themesource, the theme mxbuild builds against.
fix: Unknown key (MDL-WIDGET11, also on ALTER STYLING) and unknown option (MDL-WIDGET12) are errors; a renamed property's old name stays a warning (CE6087 is skipped for an excluded page).
insight: Measured on 11.12.6: unknown key CE6083, unknown option CE6085, declared option clean. A rule's severity rationale ('the data may be stale') must be checked against where the data comes from — here it was the same source the build uses.
